title: Add benchmark-lab performance suites, profiling baselines, representative runners and reporting pipeline v139
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: expand the benchmark lab with a new set of performance test suites, updated profiling baselines for recent kernel-selection changes, representative workload runners for multi-variant scenarios, and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that aggregates results into the metrics warehouse and the Benchmark Lab dashboard. This PR bundles the artifacts needed to run deterministic CI and nightly performance sweeps for the v139 release.

What I changed (high level): added three new perf suites covering conversational, long-context generation, and embedding-heavy workloads; updated profiling baseline JSONs produced by the new kernel selector; added representative workload runners with scheduler hooks and KV-cache warmup; introduced a reporting pipeline (Terraform + airflow DAG) that uploads aggregated CSV and experimental metadata to the metrics S3 bucket and triggers the Benchmark Lab reporting job. Also added docs and a small CI matrix entry to run the most critical performance suite on PRs.

Checklist: - [x] Performance suites authored and smoke-tested locally - [x] Profiling baselines validated against kernel selection changes - [x] Representative runners integrate with autoscaler mock and local scheduler - [x] Reporting DAG compiles and passes linter - [x] Docs updated with runbook and troubleshooting notes

Commits (summary): - 9f3b2c1 Add perf suite definitions: perf_conversation_v2.yaml, perf_long_context_v1.yaml, perf_embedding_Heavy_v1.yaml - ab4f7d2 Add representative runners with warmup and KV cache priming hooks - c32d4a8 Update profiling baselines for kernel-selector v2.3 outputs - d7e1a9b Add reporting pipeline terraform + airflow DAG and metrics uploader - f8c5e3a Add CI matrix entry and docs for running benchmark lab suites

Changed files (high level): - benchmark-lab/suites/perf_conversation_v2.yaml - benchmark-lab/suites/perf_long_context_v1.yaml - benchmark-lab/suites/perf_embedding_heavy_v1.yaml - benchmark-lab/runners/representative_runners.py - benchmark-lab/runners/kv_warmup.py - benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v139/conv_baseline.json - benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v139/longctx_baseline.json - benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v139/emb_baseline.json - reporting/pipeline/v139/main.tf - reporting/pipeline/v139/dags/benchmark_reporting_dag.py - reporting/pipeline/v139/uploader/upload_metrics.py - docs/benchmark-lab/runbook-v139.md - ci/benchmarks.yml
